# crosswork_port_groups (Resource)

This resource can manage a port group, the ports are assigned with `crosswork_assign_ports_to_port_group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_port_groups" "example" {
  name        = "cwtest-port-group"
  description = "Test port group"
  parent_uuid = "d958313a-5d5c-48aa-83ec-4918faa5286c"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique among the port groups without regard to case
- `parent_uuid` (String) Id of the parent group, which is the built-in `User Defined` group, the group of the `crosswork_groupings` data source for the classifier `UserDefinedPorts` that is built in (`discovery_type` is `StaticSystem`) and allows subgroups (`subgroups_allowed`)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_port_groups.example "<id>"
```
